title: Chapter 693
text:
The Mech Legion surrounded him, and countless cannons were aimed in the direction of the black fog figure and the Dark-star leader. Han Xiao sized up this Beyond Grade A figure that gave him a sense of pressure. His brows furrowed, and he quickly recalled the origin of this person.

Beyond Grade As were even rarer than Calamity Grades, and every one of them was a top expert in the galaxy. Han Xiao remembered the information of the various Beyond Grade As more clearly.

"Black fog body, red light spots …"

Han Xiao had a flash of inspiration. Could this guy be [EsGod], which meant 'God of Esper Abilities', a Beyond Grade A Super with a fierce reputation?

The black fog figure was very similar to the EsGod doppelganger in his memories. Han Xiao sifted through his memories and realized that the possibility of this being the EsGod doppelganger was the highest.

If that's the case, it can barely be considered a piece of good news … Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

EsGod could be considered one of the final bosses of the neutral evil faction. His name was a secret, and he was usually called 'EsGod' or 'Lord of the Fallen Ark'. He also had other nicknames, such as' Guide of Crazy Believers', 'Tide of Destruction', 'Life Slaughterer', and so on.

Even among the Beyond Grade As, EsGod's combat strength was ranked at the top, and his battle record was extremely shocking. He had never lost a single battle, and even had the record of killing a Beyond Grade A Super!

Even the three Universal Civilizations were quite wary of him.

If EsGod's main body descended, Han Xiao estimated that no one in the entire Shattered Star Ring would be his match. Even the Tyrant, Magus, and Dragon Emperor would not be able to defeat EsGod.

However, if it was just an EsGod doppelganger, although it had the pressure of a Beyond Grade A, its actual combat strength would definitely be far weaker than the main body.

Furthermore, this battlefield is advantageous to me … Han Xiao glanced at the wormholes around him and came to this conclusion.

I can fight a dozen!

These thoughts flashed through Han Xiao's mind, and he completed his judgment of the situation. He took a deep breath, calmed his restless heart, and increased his focus.

This was the first time he was facing a Beyond Grade A Super, so he was fully focused. Suddenly, he thought of something and softly communicated with Harrofal in the channel.

"Professor, both our lives are in danger now. It's not the time to be secretive. Tell me, what kind of machines do you have? I need to gather all the available power."

Harrofal only hesitated for a moment before speaking softly in the communication channel. After hearing that, Han Xiao's eyes sparkled, and he immediately had a plan. He exchanged a few words with Harrofal in the communication channel and received something that Harrofal handed over.

At this time, the EsGod doppelganger moved again and disappeared without a trace, appearing directly in the middle of the Mech Legion's formation.

Before the mechanical soldiers around him could fire at him, he teleported and disappeared again. As though there was no cooldown, he jumped crazily in the mechanical army and passed through the defense line of the mechanical army almost instantly, arriving in front of Han Xiao.

When the EsGod doppelganger teleported, Han Xiao had already reacted. First, he told Harrofal to leave the battlefield quickly before retreating. During this process, he opened up compressed orbs and released a large number of nanoparticles, turning them into hundreds of flat hexagonal metal plates. The metal plates looked like solar panels, but the mechanical circuits were more complicated. This was the 'Space Pressure Plate' used to stabilize the spacetime coordinate coefficient.

These metal plates were spread out far and wide, forming a loose spherical structure. They were very far apart from each other. The metal plates were shrouded in a distorted wave, and in the inner region of this sphere, the space-time coefficient was gradually solidified at a stable value. Even the spatial folds were flattened.

This was the product of the Cutting-Edge Knowledge [Advanced Space Application] — Space Fixation Device, specialized in dealing with all kinds of tricks!

When the EsGod doppelganger teleported in front of Han Xiao, he also fell into the range of the Space Fixation Device. His teleportation was immediately restricted, but the EsGod doppelganger did not stop at all. He gave up on teleportation and turned into an afterimage, flying at an unbelievable speed.

Just as Han Xiao had the intention to retreat, his vision suddenly turned black. The EsGod doppelganger had crossed a large distance in an instant and was face to face with him. It was almost no different from teleportation. This speed was conservatively estimated to be above three thousand Agility!

Esper Ability — Godspeed!

"Chicken is too fast!" Han Xiao was shocked and hurriedly activated his Mechanical Force.

The psionic energy reactor of the Mountain Ape mechanical suit suddenly increased, and blue electric arcs appeared on the surface of the armor. Psionic energy exploded through the mechanical suit, forming a three-hundred-sixty-degree blue shockwave with no blind spots. It exploded violently and was about to push the EsGod doppelganger away.

However, the explosive psionic energy shockwave directly passed through the body of the EsGod doppelganger as if he was just a projection that did not exist. The shockwave only caused ripples on his body, and the impact was extremely small.

Esper Ability — Dimension Crevice!

The next moment, the EsGod doppelganger materialized again and lightly pressed his palm toward Han Xiao's chest.

Han Xiao's hair stood on end, and he hurriedly stopped the Space Fixation Device from afar. He then immediately used Advanced Void Travel and escaped into the Void Dimension, preparing to dodge this punch.

He had a feeling that if he was hit by this punch, he would definitely be in big trouble!

The world in front of him seemed to have frozen, becoming countless times slower. Everything was dyed with a hazy light. After Han Xiao entered the Void Dimension, he immediately wanted to retreat.

However, he realized that the black fog on the surface of the EsGod doppelganger suddenly shook and instantly broke free from its static state, entering the Void Dimension as well!

The EsGod doppelganger opened his hand and clenched it tightly. Han Xiao could clearly see that the surrounding space seemed to have been hit in the middle, and thick light cracks appeared. Before he could think of anything else, the Void Dimension around him shattered like a broken mirror, and Han Xiao fell out of the Void Dimension and returned to the physical world.

Void Travel was directly interrupted!

At the same time, the EsGod doppelganger followed him like a shadow and approached him again, slapping down with his palm.

Han Xiao held his breath, and his intuition of danger stabbed into his heart like a sharp knife, almost causing his heart to stop beating. This was completely an instinctive reaction of his body, and he could not control it at all. He could only watch as the EsGod doppelganger's palm approached him in slow motion.

There was no way to dodge, so he could only take it head-on!

Han Xiao gritted his teeth and immediately adjusted the mechanical suit's output to full power. All kinds of buff abilities were used on him as if they did not cost money. He even activated a few Character Summon Cards that increased strength, including Nagojin's [Muscles Are Truth].

Small mechanical components protruded from the surface of the Mountain Ape mechanical suit and shook like dragon scales, generating a surge of power.

The back of the mechanical suit also revealed more than ten fan-shaped force dissipation devices. Han Xiao gathered all the strength in his body, put his arms in a parrying position, activated his energy shield, and faced the attack head-on.

His palm pressed on the psionic shield. Although it looked weak, Han Xiao felt an unparalleled force surging toward him like a tidal wave.

Esper Ability — Star Toss!

Thankfully, there was no sound in the vacuum. Otherwise, just the sound wave from this attack would be enough to kill a Super below Grade C!

Han Xiao's vision turned black, and he lost consciousness for a moment. When he came back to his senses, he realized that his body was flying out uncontrollably at the speed of a meteor, crushing all the mechanical soldiers along the way.

The EsGod doppelganger in Han Xiao's vision instantly became a small dot, and he did not know how far he had been sent flying by this attack.

The scales on the surface of the mechanical suit kept shaking to dissipate the force, but they quickly shattered and fell off. The fan-shaped force dissipation device on the back of the mechanical suit was torn to pieces the moment it was sent flying.

Han Xiao hurriedly glanced at the interface and saw that this punch had caused the armor of the Mountain Ape mechanical suit to drop by twenty-four percent. His health had also dropped by more than sixteen thousand, close to ten percent. If not for the armor and energy shield blocking it, this punch would have probably taken out two-fifths of his health. There was a series of [Strength Crush] notifications in the combat information.

"So, this is the strength of a Beyond Grade A …" Han Xiao was speechless.

The frightening thing about EsGod was that even if the Esper Abilities he absorbed were very ordinary, they could be stacked and evolve. At the same time, through his own Beyond Grade A Energy Rank, he could make these Esper Abilities exhibit the strength of a Beyond Grade A!

The most basic forms of 'Seraphic Speed' and 'Star Toss' were actually two extremely common low-grade Esper Abilities — Speed Enhancement and Strength Enhancement!

Even if it was just a doppelganger, it was still at the Beyond Grade A level!

Han Xiao tried to stabilize his body while activating the space solidification device again to restrict the teleportation ability of EsGod's doppelganger. In the short exchange just now, he had already ordered the Mech Legion to aim all the cannons at EsGod. At this moment, without any hesitation, he immediately ordered the army to open fire.

The multicolored light illuminated the universe!

Radiance drowned EsGod's doppelganger, but the next moment, it was as if a black hole was created out of thin air. The energy of these cannons turned into a whirlpool and gradually shrank. They were all absorbed by EsGod's doppelganger as though he had eaten something extremely nutritious. The dim red light on his face lit up again.

Esper Ability — Black Hole!

There was a limit to the doppelganger's energy, and the Lord of Fallen Ark would not inject too much energy into it. Therefore, EsGod's doppelganger was like Ultraman, a true man for three minutes. This wave of concentrated fire gave him a huge amount of energy.

"You f * cking cheated!" Han Xiao finally managed to stabilize his body. Seeing this scene, his mouth twitched.

I can't resist it, and I can't fight it either.

You're more of a gangster than I am!

"Hahahaha!"

The Dark-star leader, who was watching the battle from afar, almost laughed out loud when he saw this.

Originally, he was still worried that EsGod's doppelganger would not be able to suppress Black Star. Now, it seemed like his worries were unnecessary. In his eyes, EsGod's doppelganger dealing with Black Star was as easy as an adult fighting a child!

This time, Black Star definitely had no chance of escaping!

The next moment, Han Xiao turned around and ran toward the wormhole.

Seeing this, the Dark-star leader let go of all his worries. His body relaxed, and he smiled with satisfaction.

"Looks like Black Star feels that EsGod's doppelganger will threaten his life, so he wants to use the wormhole to escape. Haha, he thinks he's smart, taking the initiative to exile himself in order to survive. This saves a lot of trouble."

EsGod's doppelganger easily passed through the Mech Legion and immediately chased after him. The two of them turned into streams of light, one chasing and one escaping in the wormhole area, passing through many unstable wormholes.

Although these wormholes were unstable, generally speaking, the wormhole with the most intense energy fluctuation would be connected to the other end of the wormhole further away. This rule had not been proven, and it could be said to be the experience of the galactic residents.

EsGod's doppelganger was even faster, and he followed closely behind. His goal was to send Han Xiao into the largest wormhole in this wormhole area, which would most likely exile him even further.

In the largest wormhole nearby, Han Xiao could already feel the terrifying pulling force of space. He turned around to look at EsGod's doppelganger, who seemed to be teasing him, and clenched his teeth. He controlled the thruster, wanting to change direction and avoid this wormhole.

This time, a hoarse chuckle sounded in Han Xiao's ears, as if it was a telepathic message.

"Stop struggling, quickly take the risk with me. Going through wormholes is one of my few joys."

This sentence was the voice transmission of EsGod's doppelganger. The next moment, he teleported behind Han Xiao and grabbed Han Xiao's arm tightly. The red dot on his face shook slightly, as if forming a smile.

So, you can talk!

Han Xiao felt a headache coming on.

Immediately after, EsGod's doppelganger dragged Han Xiao into the wormhole. The two of them were instantly swallowed by the wormhole and disappeared without a trace.

The Mechanical Force bonuses of the Mech Legion all disappeared, and they stood rooted to the ground.

"Success!"

The Dark-star leader's eyes shone brightly. He could not hold back his excitement and waved his fists.

They had finally exiled Black Star, and the mission given by Klent was completed. The new home of the hybrid Godora was just around the corner!

"It's over, everything is over …"

The Dark-star leader mumbled to himself. His eyes were suddenly filled with tears, and he seemed to have seen a future full of hope.

The hybrid Godora would have their own home and would live and reproduce in the new Star Cluster. Everyone would be happy, and there would no longer be any pure-bloods who would discriminate against them. Although every hybrid looked different and came from a different race, their essence was the same. They were all new Godora.

The Dark-star leader wiped his tears and collected his thoughts. Just as he was about to turn around and leave, he suddenly thought of something and turned around to look for Harrofal.

He still remembered this Calamity Grade who had not participated in the battle. He had seen the information about this Calamity Grade, and this seemed to be a research talent of a Star Cluster civilization. He felt that he could capture him to increase his own merits.

After searching for a while, he finally found Harrofal in an area far away from the battlefield. Just as he was about to go forward to capture him, Harrofal's next action made him slightly stunned.

Harrofal did not even look at him and took out a compressed orb, which turned into a strange-looking mechanical device. It looked a little like a speaker but had a complicated multi-layer structure. Compared to a combat weapon, it looked more like a sophisticated research instrument. Eight mechanical arms extended from the machine, and the ends looked like the stylus of an ancient record player. The stylus moved along with the mechanical arms as though it was drawing a picture, leaving behind a blue trail of light.

The trail of light became deeper and deeper before suddenly expanding and turning into a blue circle of light that looked like a portal. It then contracted slightly and spat out a figure as though it was vomiting. Then, the circle of light closed instantly.

"This thing is really useful. I'll return it to you." Han Xiao stabilized himself and casually threw a mechanical beacon that was emitting black smoke to Harrofal.

"Humph, I'm a researcher. Of course, the things I research are useful. However, if you fly into a wormhole that has not been measured before, this machine won't be able to find you."

Harrofal looked at the beacon with a pained expression before keeping it in his mechanical suit. This was something that he had given to Han Xiao in the first place.

Han Xiao twisted his neck and turned to look at the stunned Dark-star leader. He placed his hands on his hips, curled his lips, and sent a voice message.
